  • TPK’s Holiday Calligraphy Worksheets: A Guide

    November 12, 2026

    by

    Lindsey Bugbee

    Calligraphy, Christmas, Holiday, Worksheets
    Listen to audio version of this article
    Sponsored by
    0:00 / 6:00
    Instaread

    Find the holiday calligraphy worksheet that fits what you’d like to make! In this guide, we’ll compare greetings, flourished motifs, and drills, with quick picks to help you choose. You’ll also find two additional winter worksheets and a link to TPK’s Holiday Collection for more projects and free printables.

    If you’re looking to add calligraphy to your holiday paper goods (or “holidaze” survival strategy), this guide will help you choose the perfect resource. In it, you’ll find nine annual holiday worksheets below, followed by two additional winter worksheets. Start with the quick picks, then take a closer look at the designs that catch your eye!

    Which Worksheet Should You Choose?

    • Do you mostly like holiday greetings? Start with the 2016 or 2017 edition. (Choose 2020 if you’d like more elaborate flourishes, including Hanukkah and Winter Solstice greetings.)
    • If you want to make artwork for cards and tags, take a look at the 2019, 2022, 2024, and 2025 editions: mixed lettering and watercolor, ornaments and wreaths, flourished birds, or fir trees and a snowflake medallion.
    • If you’re into practice without a lot of phrases, try 2021’s Holiday Edition drills for candy canes, pine boughs, mittens, etc.
    • If you’d like video demonstrations to follow, choose the 2026 edition, Wander Into Wonder. Two detailed videos walk you through its flourished candle and reindeer projects.
    • If you want one type of project to focus on, see the Winter Wonderland medallions or the Graceful Ballerina worksheet.

    You can find links to all the worksheets in their descriptions below.

    For Holiday Greetings

    TPK Holiday Calligraphy Worksheet 2016 Edition

    Choose this if you want to practice useful greetings in several calligraphy styles. You’ll work on seven phrases, including “Happy Holidays”, “Merry and Bright”, and “Feliz Navidad”, with instructions and guided writing practice. This is also the set with that flourished holiday tree that everyone likes! Try a greeting on a card front or make the tree a little piece of artwork.

    GET THE 2016 WORKSHEET

    TPK Holiday Calligraphy Worksheet 2017 Edition

    Choose this if you’d like embellished greetings and an ornate snowflake medallion. The seven phrases include “Joy & Peace”, “Warmest Wishes”, and “Have Yourself a Merry Little Christmas”. You’ll practice different styles, then bring your strokes together in a snowflake-like medallion that looks particularly fabulous on the back of an envelope.

    GET THE 2017 WORKSHEET

    TPK Holiday Calligraphy Worksheet 2020 Edition

    Choose this if flourishing is what you’d most like to practice. This set pairs five highly embellished greetings with flourished reindeer artwork and crosshatched ornament illustrations. Alongside Christmas phrases, you’ll find “Cheers to a Wonderful Winter Solstice” and “Wishing You Love & Light This Hanukkah”. (It’s a good option when you want the calligraphy itself to take center stage.)

    GET THE 2020 WORKSHEET

    For Cards, Tags, and Flourished Artwork

    TPK Holiday Calligraphy Worksheet 2019 Edition

    Choose this if you enjoy mixing calligraphy, hand-lettering, doodles, and optional watercolor. Projects include a “We Wish You a Merry Christmas” tree, “Happy Winter Solstice” lettering, a “Be Merry” ornament, and a flourished wreath. The set also includes access to a worksheet-exclusive Christmas card tutorial. There’s plenty in this worksheet set that you can adapt for cards, mail art, or bookmarks.

    GET THE 2019 WORKSHEET

    TPK Holiday Calligraphy Worksheet 2022 Edition

    Choose this if you want several decorative motifs for holiday paper goods. You’ll make three flourished ornaments, practice phrases such as “Dashing Through the Snow” and “Bah! Humbug”, and create a pointed pen wreath. The embellished holly “Merry Christmas” lettering makes a nice card centerpiece, too. This set offers a mix of calligraphy and artwork to return to throughout the season.

    GET THE 2022 WORKSHEET

    TPK Holiday Calligraphy Worksheet 2024 Edition

    Choose this if you love seasonal embellishments and flourished birds. Begin with holiday doodles, then use them alongside festive greetings. You’ll also learn a “Let it snow!” tree, a flourished partridge, and a winter cardinal. The small embellishments are useful for tags and envelopes; the birds can be the focus of a card all on their own.

    GET THE 2024 WORKSHEET

    TPK Holiday Calligraphy Worksheet 2025 Edition

    Choose this if you’d like trees, an ornament, a medallion, and phrases in one set. Start with three flourished fir trees, then try a looping ornament and a snowflake-inspired calligraphy medallion. The phrases are “Happy New Year!”, “Magic and Joy”, and “Merry Everything”. Guided steps and traceable outlines will help you practice motifs for cards, tags, and envelopes.

    GET THE 2025 WORKSHEET

    Wander Into Wonder: 2026 Holiday Calligraphy Worksheet Set

    Choose this if you’d like festive lettering and flourished artwork with detailed video help. This 13-page set includes “Celebrate”, “Good Cheer”, “Sparkle & Shine”, and “Flourishing with Joy”, plus an “All Is Bright” candle and a flourished reindeer with a customizable banner. Preparatory drills, numbered strokes, tracing, and independent practice guide you through the designs. Two detailed video demonstrations show you how to make the candle and reindeer (the page address and password are included in the worksheet).

    GET THE 2026 WORKSHEET

    For Cozy Calligraphy Drills

    Not Your Average Calligraphy Drills: Holiday Edition (2021)

    Choose this if you want seasonal pen practice rather than a collection of greetings. Rectangular, square, and circular drills will turn your strokes into candy canes, pine boughs, mittens, and other cozy motifs. The set finishes with a holly-and-berries medallion and a friendly “Happy Holidays” snowman, so you’ll have a couple of nice artwork ideas to use after practicing.

    GET THE HOLIDAY DRILLS WORKSHEET

    Two More Winter Worksheets

    These worksheets focus on a particular kind of motif, rather than offering a full annual holiday assortment. They’re good options if you’d like to spend your practice time on medallions or a single flourished figure.

    Winter Wonderland Calligraphy Medallions Worksheet

    Choose this if you enjoy repeating strokes to build an impressive design. The four medallions in the Winter Wonderland Calligraphy Medallions Worksheet are “Winter Abundance”, “Winter Feathers”, “Snowflake”, and “Winter Bouquet”. Detailed instructions, tracing practice, and practice circles help you put them together.

    GET THE WINTER WONDERLAND WORKSHEET

    Graceful Ballerina Calligraphy Drill Worksheet

    Choose this if you’d like to turn a few flourishes into a recognizable figure. Loops, a flourished tutu, and long strokes form a graceful ballerina. Color-coded instructions, warm-up drills, and traceable practice guide you through the motif. If the season makes you think of the Nutcracker, try adding this lovely dancer to an envelope, card, or gift tag!

    GET THE BALLERINA WORKSHEET

    Additional Holiday Inspiration

    ‘Tis the season! You can visit Holiday at TPK: A Creative Collection to browse holiday projects, free printables, and tutorials. A few tutorials are free and others are part of TPK Premium (the collection notes the access details so you can find something that suits you).

    EXPLORE THE HOLIDAY COLLECTION

    Whether you plan to tackle a worksheet or make something from the holiday collection, I hope you find a project you’re excited to make. Thanks so much for reading, and happy holidays!

    Warmly,

About The Postman’s Knock (TPK)

Hi, I’m Lindsey Bugbee, the illustrator, calligrapher, and author behind The Postman’s Knock (TPK). Since 2012, the TPK Blog has been a vibrant creative space filled with tutorials and lessons on modern calligraphy, hand lettering, and illustration. After publishing The Calligraphy Book, I wanted to elevate the quality of content even further—so I launched TPK Premium. You can join here to receive access to some of the internet’s best creative inspiration and project tutorials.
